title: 1995 AHSME Problem 12
statement: Let \(f\) be a linear function with the properties that \(f(1)\le f(2),\) \(f(3)\ge f(4),\) and \(f(5)=5.\) Which of the following statements is true?

solutions.text: From \(f(1)\le f(2),\) the slope is nonnegative. From \(f(3)\ge f(4),\) it is nonpositive. Thus the slope is \(0,\) so \(f\) is constant. Since \(f(5)=5,\) we have \(f(0)=5.\) Thus the correct answer is D.
hints: Translate each inequality into a condition on the slope
The two slope conditions together determine the entire linear function
